name: elastic-pull-card
title: Elastic Pull Card
description: A tethered specimen card that stretches from its anchor point with rubberband tension before snapping back.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Tethered Pull Rebound: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
